observerQueries.identities: select pid,backend_start,usename,state,xact_start,wait_event_type,wait_event from pg_catalog.pg_stat_activity where pid = any($1::integer[])

observerQueries.locks: select pid,locktype,mode,granted,classid,objid,objsubid,transactionid from pg_catalog.pg_locks where pid = any($1::integer[])
observerQueries.note: Read-only query TEXT, NOT executed or standalone psql installer. Excludes query text/address/unit/token values. Observer privilege and visibility must be scoped and approved; missing visibility = abort.
